description: Looks up an Exchange Online mailbox by user principal name, Entra object ID, or email address, and returns its details. Set exactly one of the three lookup attributes.

user_principal_name.description: Look the mailbox up by user principal name, e.g. sales@contoso.com. Set exactly one of user_principal_name, object_id or email_address.

object_id.description: Look the mailbox up by its Entra ID object ID (the mailbox's ExternalDirectoryObjectId). Set exactly one of user_principal_name, object_id or email_address.

email_address.description: Look the mailbox up by any of its SMTP addresses, primary or secondary. Set exactly one of user_principal_name, object_id or email_address.

found.description: Whether a mailbox matched. A data source that finds nothing is not an error - check this before using any other attribute, because they are all null when it is false.

mailbox_guid.description: The mailbox's Exchange directory GUID. This is the value exchangeonlinemanagement_mailbox uses as its Terraform id, so it is what you pass to terraform import.

external_directory_object_id.description: The mailbox's Entra ID object ID - the same value the object_id lookup attribute takes.

effective_user_principal_name.description: The mailbox's user principal name. Named effective_ because user_principal_name is a lookup attribute and one attribute cannot be both.

email_addresses.description: Every proxy address on the mailbox, prefix included (SMTP:, smtp:, SIP:, SPO:).

recipient_type_details.description: Exchange's specific classification: SharedMailbox, UserMailbox, RoomMailbox, EquipmentMailbox and so on.

hidden_from_address_lists.description: Whether the mailbox is hidden from address lists.

litigation_hold_enabled.description: Whether the mailbox is on litigation hold.

is_directory_synced.description: Whether the underlying object is synchronised from on-premises Active Directory.

deliver_to_mailbox_and_forward.description: Whether forwarded mail is also kept in the mailbox.

forwarding_smtp_address.description: The external forwarding address, if one is set.

retention_policy.description: The retention policy applied to the mailbox.

issue_warning_quota.description: Quota at which the user is warned, as Exchange reports it.

prohibit_send_quota.description: Quota at which the mailbox can no longer send.

prohibit_send_receive_quota.description: Quota at which the mailbox can no longer send or receive.

max_send_size.description: Largest message the mailbox may send.

max_receive_size.description: Largest message the mailbox may receive.

custom_attributes.description: Exchange custom attributes 1 through 15, keyed "1" .. "15". Attributes with no value are omitted.

mailbox_json.description: The whole Get-Mailbox object as JSON, for the many properties this data source does not model explicitly. Read it with jsondecode(). Values are normalised for stable state: dates are ISO 8601 strings, multi-valued properties are string arrays, and everything else is stringified.
